record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare POWDER_SNOW: Snom (1 star) and Frosmoth (2 stars). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index). Both have maxPP 80, range 3, no passive.
record.summary: Deals SPECIAL damage (raw 20/40/80/160 by stars) to every enemy-team unit on a straight line from the caster through the cast target, extended to the board edge, and gives each enemy hit an independent chance (15% / 30% / 50% / 100% by stars; caster's luck applies) to be frozen for a base 2000 ms. The freeze roll happens for every enemy on the line after its damage call, whether or not that damage was blocked (protect / skydiving / magicBounce block damage only; skydiving and Rune Protect are rejected inside triggerFreeze).

targeting.who: every enemy-team entity on the cells of the supercover line from the caster's cell toward the cast target and on to a point 12 cells away along the same angle (clipped to the board); the caster's own cell is filtered out as same-team
targeting.note: The target only fixes the line's angle: it is hit only if its cell lies on the computed line (effectInLine has no fall-back that touches the original target). Enemies behind the target are hit too. Allies are skipped.

geometry.shape: line (supercover) from the caster through the cast target to the board edge; every touched cell counts, diagonal crossings included

effects.target: each enemy-team unit on the line (each cell visited once)
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] per enemy hit, no falloff along the line. handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); x (1 + (critPower - 1) x critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with a DOUBLE_DAMAGE effect (consumed by the first hit); x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 when the unit has protect / skydiving / magicBounce (see core-mechanics §A/§J).

statusEffects.target: each enemy-team unit on the line (independent roll)
statusEffects.scaling: none from AP or crit; chance by caster stars through chance(p, caster), so the caster's luck raises it (p ^ (1 - luck/100)); the duration is a flat 2000 requested.
statusEffects.resolution: applied only if the hit unit is not already frozen, has no rune protect or skydiving, and its ccCooldown is <= 0. The call is `cell.value.status.triggerFreeze(2000, cell.value, pokemon)`, so the IMMUNITY_FREEZE check, weather (SNOW x1.3 reduced by 20% per Icy Rock of the hit unit's player; DROUGHT x0.7), enraged halving and status-duration reductions are evaluated against the HIT unit itself. Applied duration = Math.round of the adjusted value. Freeze then wears off faster if the unit is also burning. The roll is independent of whether the damage was blocked or dealt.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars (1 and 2 for the listed units, bare factory values); the 3-star and 4-star columns (80/160 damage, 50%/100% freeze) are not reachable by the bare factory star counts of the listed units. Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Which enemies are hit depends on the caster and target coordinates (angle rounding of the line end point). Range 3 means the cast target may be up to 3 cells away, but the line continues to the board edge.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and recomputes the line; a unit already frozen is not re-frozen and the freeze timer is not extended; a unit that just ended a freeze has a crowd-control cooldown (ccCooldown) that blocks a new freeze.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 20/40 (1/2 stars of the listed units) per enemy on the line, freeze 2000 ms at 15%/30%. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. Applied freeze duration is computed from the hit unit's own context (weather, enraged, reductions), unlike AURORA_BEAM.
